class.name: IfcApprovalRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcApprovalRelationship associates approvals (one relating approval and one or more related approvals), each having different status or level as the approval process or the approved objects evolve. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x2. IFC2x4 CHANGE Subtyped from IfcResourceLevelRelationship , order of attributes changed.

members.member: The approval that other approval is related to.

The approvals that are related to another (relating) approval. IFC2x Edition 4 CHANGE The cardinality of this attribute has been changed to SET. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
